title: Software Developer
summary: Software Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed microservices using Java 8/17, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA. Proven expertise in building RESTful APIs, event-driven and asynchronous workflows with Apache Kafka, and containerized deployments on Docker and Kubernetes. Skilled in system design (HLD/LLD), SQL and query optimization, performance tuning, and CI/CD automation with GitLab and Jenkins. Strong collaborator in Agile telecom OSS/BSS delivery for Telstra and Bell Canada. Actively seeking a Backend / Java Developer role to build high-performance, cloud-native applications.

bullets: Built a Spring Boot microservice that generates XML offer catalogs consumed by a downstream provisioning system, onboarding 1,100+ roaming offers, price plans, and entitlements for enterprise subscribers.

Delivered 8+ features covering flat-rate offer generation and active-plan eligibility validation, cutting invalid catalog output by 22% and centralizing error handling, KPI tracking, and audit logging in a shared validation utility.
Authored 100+ JUnit and Serenity BDD tests wired into GitLab CI/CD with feature-toggle rollout, reaching 85%+ code coverage across all plan flows.
Collaborated with architects and product owners on low-level design, effort estimation, code reviews, and risk analysis for every sprint release.

Developed and maintained 20+ Spring Boot microservices on PostgreSQL for telecom OSS platforms, supporting 100K+ daily service orders through Kafka-based event-driven orchestration and automated order fulfilment.

Enhanced the Service Order Management (SOM) platform, improving end-to-end order processing efficiency by 30%, and led the migration of 30+ REST APIs to a new Apigee API management platform with updated security policies.
Architected an inventory management module with advanced filtering and pagination, improving data retrieval efficiency by 40% for key business users.
Improved application performance by 25–35% through SQL query optimization, indexing, connection pooling, Redis caching, and JVM-level performance tuning.
Deployed and managed 15+ containerized microservices on Kubernetes, achieving 99.99% availability and cutting deployment time by 50% by optimizing the Parallel MEC Distribution process.
Built a SoapUI automation framework that reduced manual testing effort by 40% and execution time by 60%, while delivering 30+ features across 10+ production releases in an Agile environment.
Developed AMEND and CANCEL functionality for the Complex Logistics microservice, extending telecom order lifecycle management across multiple lines of business.
Resolved 200+ defects across SIT and UAT through root cause analysis, and reached 100% security compliance by remediating SonarQube and Docker vulnerabilities.
Increased JUnit and Mockito test coverage from 30% to over 80%, cutting critical production defects to zero and reducing technical debt by 40%.
Delivered 30+ features with cross-functional Agile teams, sustaining sprint completion rates above 90% and on-time release execution.

education.degree: Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Computer Science | CGPA 9.02
